prerequisites: Willingness to engage with abstract concepts
quiz_adaptations: Focus foundational topics due to 0% scores in general, learning_style, and mathematical areas
Incorporate reinforcement of basics in logical reasoning and problem solving
Include motivational elements as motivation score is high

modules.title: Foundations of Logical Reasoning
modules.description: This module introduces core concepts of logic and reasoning essential for technology applications.
objectives: Differentiate between valid and invalid arguments

sub_modules.title: Introduction to Logic
sub_modules.description: An overview of what constitutes logical thinking and its importance in technological contexts.
learning_outcomes: Define key terms related to logic
Identify examples of logical reasoning in daily life

activities.title: Logic Vocabulary Builder
activities.description: Interactive activity focusing on building foundational vocabulary used in logical reasoning.
learning_objectives: Learn definitions of premise, conclusion, inference

activities.title: Real-world Logic Examples
activities.description: Explore how logical reasoning applies in real-life situations using case studies from tech.
learning_objectives: Identify logical structures in practical examples
assessment_criteria: Explanation of logical flow in examples

sub_modules.title: Types of Logical Statements
sub_modules.description: Dive into conditional statements, conjunctions, disjunctions, and negations commonly found in programming and system design.
learning_outcomes: Classify different types of logical statements
Translate natural language into formal logic notation

activities.title: Statement Classification Practice
activities.description: Practice identifying and categorizing various kinds of logical statements through interactive exercises.

activities.title: Symbolic Translation Workshop
activities.description: Hands-on workshop converting English sentences into symbolic logic form.

modules.title: Critical Thinking Fundamentals
modules.description: Develop skills necessary for analyzing information critically within technical domains.

sub_modules.title: Understanding Facts vs Opinions
sub_modules.description: Learn to distinguish objective facts from subjective opinions in technical writing and communication.

activities.title: Fact or Opinion Sorting Game
activities.description: Engaging game where learners sort statements into categories based on whether they are facts or opinions.

activities.title: Evidence-Based Evaluation Exercise
activities.description: Exercise evaluating claims by checking their supportability with verifiable data or references.

sub_modules.title: Bias Recognition and Mitigation
sub_modules.description: Recognize potential biases that can influence decision-making processes in technology fields.
learning_outcomes: Detect cognitive and media bias indicators
Implement strategies to minimize bias impact

activities.title: Bias Identification Challenge
activities.description: Interactive challenge involving spotting hidden biases in news articles and product reviews.

activities.title: Bias Reduction Simulation
activities.description: Simulation task requiring participants to adjust inputs to reduce perceived bias in hypothetical project decisions.
learning_objectives: Adjust parameters to achieve balanced outcomes
Reflect on personal biases affecting choices

modules.title: Problem Solving Strategies
modules.description: Master structured approaches to solving complex problems typical in computing environments.
objectives: Break down large issues into manageable components

sub_modules.title: Structured Problem-Solving Frameworks
sub_modules.description: Introduce widely accepted methodologies such as root cause analysis and decomposition techniques.

activities.title: Root Cause Analysis Toolkit
activities.description: Guided practice applying fishbone diagrams and five whys technique to identify underlying causes.

activities.title: Decomposition Techniques Workshop
activities.description: Workshop demonstrating how to split multifaceted challenges into smaller solvable units.

sub_modules.title: Solution Validation Methods
sub_modules.description: Teach ways to test proposed resolutions before full implementation including prototyping and peer review.
learning_outcomes: Design preliminary tests for new ideas

activities.title: Prototype Testing Lab
activities.description: Hands-on lab session creating mockups or simulations to trial initial concepts safely.

activities.title: Peer Review Simulation
activities.description: Simulated environment mimicking collaborative review meetings to refine solution proposals.

modules.title: Mathematical Foundations for Logic
modules.description: Reinforce mathematical understanding crucial for advanced logical operations like Boolean algebra and set theory.
objectives: Grasp fundamental math needed for logic
Perform calculations relevant to computational models
Connect mathematical concepts to logical constructs

sub_modules.title: Sets and Relations Basics
sub_modules.description: Review sets, subsets, unions, intersections, and relations which underpin database designs and algorithms.

activities.title: Set Operations Drills
activities.description: Series of drill exercises reinforcing union, intersection, difference, complement operations.
learning_objectives: Execute all basic set operations confidently

activities.title: Relations Mapping Tasks
activities.description: Tasks mapping ordered pairs representing relationships between entities similar to relational databases.
learning_objectives: Identify properties like reflexivity and transitivity

sub_modules.title: Boolean Algebra Essentials
sub_modules.description: Study Boolean logic rules governing digital circuits and programming control flows.

activities.title: Truth Table Construction
activities.description: Construct truth tables manually and via software tools to understand logic gate behaviors.
learning_objectives: Link entries back to logic gates

activities.title: Expression Simplification Exercises
activities.description: Exercises simplifying Boolean equations using identities like De Morgan's laws.
